definitions.support: truth used BOTH to draw the rows and to call a cell charged: 'hits' = ost61/denoise_truth (25 e- cut per group x wire x tick sample), 'complete' = denoise_truth_complete (no cut)
definitions.charged: q > 0 under the support truth (the presence target is y = log1p(q/Q0) > 0)
definitions.deploy: every fine cell (2 wires x 16 ticks) covered by a token in any band (cell_inputs idx >= 0), i.e. what the deployed model is queried on
definitions.train: unique token-covered rows of DenoiseEvents.rows with the checkpoints' recipe, pooled over draws
definitions.stratifier: 'hd' = density from the HITS truth, 'cd' = from the COMPLETE truth: charge (e-) within +-8 fine cells (17x17 cells = 34 wires x 272 ticks), the cell excluded, binned as dense/analyze.py
definitions.r_train: charged rows / rows in the stratum
definitions.r_deploy: charged covered cells / covered cells in the stratum
definitions.odds_ratio: [r_train/(1-r_train)] / [r_deploy/(1-r_deploy)]: the factor by which the training prior inflates the odds of 'charged'; a calibrated-under-training presence logit is high by log(OR)

windows_note: distances: chessboard, fine cells (1 = 2 wires or 16 ticks), from the window box (16x8 cells) to the nearest cell with charge above the threshold; d=0 means charge inside the window
